subject.title: Feature request: session:reset hook event for memory persistence on auto-resets

question: Should automatic daily/idle rollover reuse the existing internal command plus plugin `before_reset` surfaces, or establish a dedicated typed session-reset lifecycle event?
rationale: Both shapes solve persistence, but the choice defines a durable workspace/plugin API and whether automatic lifecycle events are represented as commands.

options.title: Reuse Existing Reset Surfaces
options.body: Land the active candidate after proof, using typed daily/idle reasons and strict no-double-fire guards without adding another public hook family.

options.title: Add Typed Session Reset Event
options.body: Define a dedicated session lifecycle event and migrate bundled session-memory to it, accepting the broader API and documentation work.

options.title: Pause Hook Expansion
options.body: Keep automatic rollover archive-only and pursue a separate core memory-flush design instead of exposing reset persistence hooks.

recommendation.title: Reuse Existing Reset Surfaces
recommendation.body: Land the active candidate after proof, using typed daily/idle reasons and strict no-double-fire guards without adding another public hook family.

likelyOwner.reason: They repaired and validated the active implementation and are the strongest current hooks/session routing signal.
